title: oreogrammitis merrillii
intro: Oreogrammitis merrillii, commonly known as the Merritt's fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of the Philippines and is often used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Oreogrammitis merrillii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
